title: House Bill 1, 2025 Regular Session, "Build Up Mississippi Act", As Sent to Governor (approved by the Governor 27 March 2025)
status: Enacted. Section 1 amends Miss. Code s 27-7-5 (individual income tax rates); Section 2 provides further reductions from 2031. The other sections (sales, use, fuel taxes, PERS) are not income tax.

later_bills_checked.note: The 2026 code-section index for s 27-7-5 lists three bills (SB 2869, SB 2870, SB 3031), each "Died In Committee"; so s 27-7-5 stands as amended by this Act.
